reading.body:
CyrusOne SAT1 in San Antonio is a 9 MW, 110,000-square-foot data center with compliance certifications, but its small scale limits its role in large AI training or inference clusters.

SAT1 ranks 14th in published capacity across Texas, holding 1.9% of the state's 475 MW of disclosed data center IT load. Texas has 133 mapped facilities, but only 19 publish power figures, so SAT1 is among a small set of disclosed sites statewide. The state's disclosed footprint places it behind only California and Virginia in AI-relevant capacity.

At 9 MW, SAT1 is small to mid-size by modern AI standards. This scale limits its applicability to large distributed training runs or the largest inference clusters. It remains suitable for regulated workloads, smaller teams, or as part of a multi-site deployment, given its HIPAA, PCI DSS, FISMA, ISO 27001, SSAE 16 Type II, and TIA-942 certifications. The published specifications do not indicate backup power capacity, renewable sourcing, or grid connection details.
